MPs Speaking:Dr Toh Chin Chye (Deputy Prime Minister and Leader of the House); Mr Ong Pang Boon (Minister for Home Affairs); Mr Yong Nyuk Lin (Minister for Education); Dr Lee Siew Choh; Madam Hoe Puay Choo; Miss Fung Yin Ching; Mr David Marshall; Mr Tan Cheng Tong; Mrs Seow Peck Leng; Mr John Mammen (Deputy Speaker); Sir George Oehlers (Mr Speaker);

YANG DI-PERTUAN NEGARA'S
SPEECH
(Debate on the Address)


Sitting resumed at 5.30 p.m.

[Mr SPEAKER in the Chair]



    Question again proposed.

    Mr Tan Cheng Tong(In Mandarin): Mr Speaker, Sir, before I go on to the main issue, I feel that this question of quorum is quite important. I wish to draw attention to the Standing Order on the quorum.

    Notice taken that thirteen Members were not present.

    Members summoned as if for a division pursuant to the Standing Order, and meeting resumed upon a quorum being then present.

    Mr Tan Cheng Tong(In Mandarin): Mr Speaker. Sir, I would like to go on with my speech
